thread: maya: Posting updated sidecar mock for trace details (left rail) — trying to address keyboard focus & copy affordance. https://figma.com/s/trace-sidecar (TL;DR: move correlation id to top, add visible focus ring, change 'Copy' to 'Copy trace link'). Thoughts? cj: Love moving corr id up. small nit: contrast of the copy icon text is ~3.2:1 — needs 4.5:1 for small text. Also the focus ring looks too thin on the mock. alex_r: Agree on contrast. Dev Q: can we add a single-key shortcut when the sidecar is focused? e.g. press `c` to copy corr id? Would be nice for power users. samir_m: From runtime side: permalink should include enough routing info (model+request/corr id) so it resolves across rollouts. Also: for bulk exports prefer ndjson (newline-delimited JSON). CSV loses nested stack frames. joanne_a11y: A11y notes: when sidecar opens, focus must be trapped inside and announced. Add aria-labels like "Correlation ID, copy to clipboard" on the copy button. Ensure toasts use role="status" (but avoid double announcements). maya: Good calls. On the label: thinking "Copy trace link" vs "Copy permalink" — leaning toward explicitness: "Copy trace link". Also will add visible keyboard hint in tooltip. cj: "Copy trace link" 👍. For the focus ring, use 3px outline + #0a84ff (high contrast). Also badge text size: bump to 13px for readability. alex_r: Implementation notes: add clipboard fallback for older browsers, and use aria-live polite for the toast. Export menu should be keyboard-navigable; aria-haspopup="menu" + arrow keys to move between formats. samir_m: Backend note: support deep param `?corr=` that maps to the index and snapshot id so permalinks don't 404 after hot rollouts. I'll add a small endpoint change. maya: UX followups I'm adding to the mock: 1) keyboard hint next to copy button, 2) show truncated corr id with full id in aria-label, 3) export button text default to "Export traces (ndjson)" and menu for other formats. OK? joanne_a11y: Truncated visual is fine as long as the full id is in the DOM for screen readers (e.g., `full-id` or `aria-label=""`). Also check badge contrast: white on teal at 12px fails WCAG. alex_r: Quick keyboard stub we can implement: ``` When sidecar is open: Tab -> cycle focus inside panel c -> copy correlation id e -> open export menu Esc -> close panel ``` Add aria example for copy button: `
